```{ r Load DEG results}

deg_results_jmf <- readRDS("/Users/adeyawyatt/Desktop/BLCL_ND_Exposure_Screens/Jose_BLCL_DEG.list_100125.rds") # put path to the file i sent you here
```

```{r}

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. CYTOKINES (Dictionary Hits + Strict List)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cytokine_ligands <- c(
  "IL32", "IL7", "IL15", "IL16", "IL19", "EBI3",
  "TNF", "LTA", "TNFSF9", "TNFSF10", "TNFSF11", "TNFSF13B", "TNFSF14", "CD70",
  "TGFB1", "BMP6", "GDF11", "VEGFA", "VEGFB",
  "DDT", "NAMPT", "GRN", "HMGB1", "CD40LG" # CD40L official HGNC symbol
)

# Core signaling receptors from your strict list
cytokine_receptors <- c(
  "IL2RA", "IL2RB", "IL2RG", "IL3RA", "IL4R", "IL6R", "IL6ST", "IL9R", 
  "IL10RA", "IL10RB", "IL12RB1", "IL12RB2", "IL15RA", "IL17RA", "IL17RB", 
  "IL18R1", "IL18BP", "IL20RB", "IL21R", "IL23R", "IL27RA",
  "TNFRSF1A", "TNFRSF1B", "TNFRSF8", "TNFRSF10A", "TNFRSF10B", "TNFRSF10D", 
  "TNFRSF13B", "TNFRSF13C", "TNFRSF14", "TNFRSF17", "TNFRSF19",
  "TGFBR1", "TGFBR3", "ENG", "BMPR1A", "BMPR2",
  "IFNAR1", "IFNAR2", "IFNGR1", "IFNGR2", "IFNLR1",
  "CSF2RB", "LEPR", "GHR", "CMKLR1", "CD74", "CD44"
)

# Downstream responsive / non-coding / modulator elements
cytokine_downstream_modulators <- c(
  "IL4I1", "TNFAIP1", "TNFAIP2", "TNFAIP3", "TNFAIP8", "TNFAIP8L1",
  "TGFBRAP1", "LTBP1", "LTBP4", "TWSG1", "IFNG-AS1", "CSF1"
)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. CHEMOKINES & RECEPTORS
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
chemokine_ccl <- c(
  "CCL1", "CCL2", "CCL3", "CCL3L1", "CCL3L3", "CCL4", "CCL4L1", "CCL4L2", 
  "CCL5", "CCL7", "CCL8", "CCL11", "CCL13", "CCL14", "CCL15", "CCL16", 
  "CCL17", "CCL18", "CCL19", "CCL20", "CCL21", "CCL22", "CCL23", "CCL24", 
  "CCL25", "CCL26", "CCL27", "CCL28"
)

chemokine_cxcl <- c(
  "CXCL1", "CXCL2", "CXCL3", "CXCL4", "CXCL4V1", "CXCL5", "CXCL6", "PPBP", 
  "CXCL8", "CXCL9", "CXCL10", "CXCL11", "CXCL12", "CXCL13", "CXCL14", 
  "CXCL16", "CXCL17"
)

chemokine_other <- c("XCL1", "XCL2", "CX3CL1")

chemokine_receptors <- c("CCR7")

# Standardized HGNC symbols for your specific dictionary results
dictionary_hgnc <- c("CD40LG", "IFNB1", "IFNG", "IFNW1", "IL1B", "IL2", "IL13", "IL15", "IL21", "IL32")

# Combine everything into one single master vector
chemo_cyto_list <- unique(c(
  cytokine_ligands,
  cytokine_receptors,
  cytokine_downstream_modulators,
  chemokine_ccl,
  chemokine_cxcl,
  chemokine_other,
  chemokine_receptors,
  dictionary_hgnc
))

# Alphabetize the final list for readability
chemo_cyto_list <- sort(chemo_cyto_list)

# Verify the length of your final target features
print(length(chemo_cyto_list)) # final list of genes 





```


```{r Heatmap Across Union Genes (annotated)}


# union genes = unique set of genes that are statistically significant 


# Step 1: get union DEG gene names (significant anywhere)
union_cytokine_genes <- deg_results_jmf %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)",q_value < 0.001, gene_short_name %in% chemo_cyto_list) %>%
  pull(gene_short_name) %>%
  unique()

# Step 2: build matrix (genes x exposures)
mat <- deg_results_jmf %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  filter(gene_short_name %in% union_cytokine_genes) %>%
  group_by(gene_short_name, Exposure) %>%
  summarise(mean_effect = mean(normalized_effect), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Exposure, values_from = mean_effect, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_short_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

row_anno <- data.frame(
  Category = case_when(
    rownames(mat) %in% cytokine_ligands               ~ "Cytokine ligand",
    rownames(mat) %in% cytokine_receptors             ~ "Cytokine receptor",
    rownames(mat) %in% cytokine_downstream_modulators ~ "Cytokine modulator",
    rownames(mat) %in% chemokine_ccl                  ~ "CCL chemokine",
    rownames(mat) %in% chemokine_cxcl                 ~ "CXCL chemokine",
    rownames(mat) %in% chemokine_other                ~ "Chemokine (other)",
    rownames(mat) %in% chemokine_receptors            ~ "Chemokine receptor",
    rownames(mat) %in% dictionary_hgnc                ~ "Cytokine ligand", # these overlap
    TRUE                                              ~ "Other"
  ),
  row.names = rownames(mat)
)

# Custom colors for each category
anno_colors <- list(
  Category = c(
    "Cytokine ligand"    = "#E41A1C",
    "Cytokine receptor"  = "#FF7F00",
    "Cytokine modulator" = "#FDBF6F",
    "CCL chemokine"      = "#377EB8",
    "CXCL chemokine"     = "#A6CEE3",
    "Chemokine (other)"  = "#984EA3",
    "Chemokine receptor" = "#4DAF4A",
    "Other"              = "grey80"
  )
)

pheatmap(mat,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         clustering_method = "complete",
         annotation_row = row_anno,
         annotation_colors = anno_colors,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
         breaks = seq(-0.15, 0.15, length.out = 101),
         fontsize_row = 6,
         fontsize_col = 10,
         angle_col = 45,
         main = "Cytokine/chemokine union DEGs (q < 0.001 in ≥1 condition)",
         filename = "chemo_cyto_curated_heatmap_annotated.pdf",
         width = 9, height = 16)



```
